_readme: Inputs to tools/GenerateThirdPartyNotices.cs. NuGet packages are discovered automatically from the restored project; this file only holds what cannot be discovered.

static.name: bsdiff
details: Used in: the delta patch generator, a C# port of bsdiff's matching algorithm and
its suffix-array construction (qsufsort, after Larsson and Sadakane's "Faster Suffix Sorting").

static.name: Zstandard
details: ZstdSharp.Port is a port of Zstandard, so its license applies as well.

static.name: Material-Editor
details: Used in: the BGSM/BGEM material reader and writer (CollectiveModdingToolkit.Materials), a port of
its MaterialLib. Original decoding of version 2 files by gibbed; version 20 and later by jonwd7.

static.name: Fira Sans / Fira Mono
details: FiraMono-Bold.ttf, FiraMono-Medium.ttf, FiraMono-Regular.ttf, FiraSans-Black.ttf, FiraSans-BlackItalic.ttf, FiraSans-Bold.ttf, FiraSans-BoldItalic.ttf, FiraSans-ExtraBold.ttf, FiraSans-ExtraBoldItalic.ttf, FiraSans-ExtraLight.ttf, FiraSans-ExtraLightItalic.ttf, FiraSans-Italic.ttf, FiraSans-Light.ttf, FiraSans-LightItalic.ttf, FiraSans-Medium.ttf, FiraSans-MediumItalic.ttf, FiraSans-Regular.ttf, FiraSans-SemiBold.ttf, FiraSans-SemiBoldItalic.ttf, FiraSans-Thin.ttf, FiraSans-ThinItalic.ttf

overrides._readme: Keyed by NuGet package id; a trailing * matches a prefix, the longest match wins. Fields: repo (GitHub URL, when the package metadata has none or only a redirect link), ref (commit/tag/branch; default is the commit from the package metadata), licensePath (path of the license file in the repo), name (display name of the group), skipBundledNotices (do not include the THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES file shipped inside the package), note (why).

SkiaSharp*.name: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp
SkiaSharp*.note: The package metadata only links to a go.microsoft.com redirect.

Svg.Custom.name: Svg.Custom
Svg.Custom.note: Derived from SVG.NET and under the Microsoft Public License, unlike the rest of Svg.Skia.

System.IO.Hashing.name: .NET
System.IO.Hashing.note: Its bundled notices repeat the runtime pack's.

CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.name: .NET Community Toolkit (CommunityToolkit.Mvvm)
CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.note: Its ThirdPartyNotices.txt covers code in other packages of that repository, not this one.
